items.description: Holiday Inn Express ®Cartagena Manga Hotel is located in the Manga heart residential neighborhood and next to Pie de la Popa neighborhood. It is located just 10 minutes walking to Port Society of Cartagena and to the Convention Center of Cartagena in a cab. Cartagena Convention center is the place to develoment of main congress and events of Cartagena. Whether you are traveling for business or pleasure, our individualized fast and convenient service seeks to meet all your needs and you keep in touch with your office from our the Business Center with free Internet access. Our cozy atmosphere and efficient design will make your stay your best travel experience.Get the best night of sleep in comfortable rooms, keep your workout routine in the gym in front of Popa Hill, enjoy a breakfast bar and menú restaurant served on the 10th floor of the hotel, while enjoying a wonderful view to the port of Cartagena. Take a moment for yourself and enjoy the pool on the 10th floor with panoramic view of the city and Cartagena Bay. Also you can make your corporate events and social meetings in our venues with capacity for 200 people.We are also surrounded by the most important sports venues in the city such as: Chico de Hierro Coliseum,11 de Noviembre Abel Leal baseball stadium, Jaime Morón soccer stadium, Los Leones Menor Baseball Stadium, Norton Madrid Volleyball Coliseum, Cartagena rackets complex and Bernardo Caraballo Covered Coliseum.

items.name: Cartagena Bocagrande
items.address: Avenida San Martin Cra 2 N° 9-54, Cartagena, 13001, CO
items.pet_policy: We accept pets guide dogs and emotional support dogs for a fee of 42 USD plus VAT per night This fee covers special room cleaning A vaccination certificate is required and the animal must be supervised at all times
items.parking_description: Free parking available in one of 67 spaces located on the third floor. The vehicles take the car elevator located in Carrera 3 Nº 9-55. There, our staff in charge drives the vehicle and communicates the policies and standards of the service.
items.description: Holiday Inn Express® in Cartagena Holiday Inn Express® Cartagena Bocagrande is located in the heart of the tourist area of Cartagena. We stand out for our fast, personalized, and timely service: ideal to respond to all your needs, whether you are traveling for business or pleasure. Our warm atmosphere and efficient design allow us to give you an unparalleled experience among hotels in Cartagena. Rest like nowhere else in our comfortable rooms, exercise in the gym with views of the Walled City, and enjoy the courtesy express breakfast bar served on the 14th floor of the hotel while admiring the incomparable Cartagena Bay. Do not leave without relaxing with a massage in our spa rooms or having a pleasant time in the panoramic pool located on the roof of the hotel. We are also trusted allies for your events. We put at your disposal six rooms with a capacity for up to 110 people, equipped with audiovisual devices and our exclusive catering service. In addition, you can keep in touch with your work from our Business Center with complimentary Internet service. As you can see, the Holiday Inn Express® has everything you need in a hotel in Cartagena, Colombia.

items.description: Framed by the Caribbean Sea and Cartagena Bay, InterContinental Cartagena brings together contemporary luxury, award-winning gastronomy, personalized service and meticulous attention to detail. Located in Bocagrande, Cartagena's modern waterfront district, just minutes from the UNESCO World Heritage Walled City, it offers ocean and bay view accommodations, destination weddings, exceptional meetings and immersive Caribbean experiences.

items.description: Holiday Inn Cartagena Morros is the perfect hotel to combine your beach getaway with the warm Caribbean atmosphere of Colombia. We are the only hotel in the area with a garden, offering tables and sun loungers so our guests can enjoy the vibrant energy of direct beach access. We are located in the most modern area of the city, known as Cartagena’s Dream City. Just 6 minutes from Rafael Núñez International Airport (CTG) and within walking distance of the Las Américas Convention Center.The Walled City, the foundation of Cartagena’s history and culture, is only 12 minutes from the hotel. All our rooms feature views of the sea and the lagoon, ideal for enjoying sunrise and sunset, as well as birdwatching.
